optimistic_updates.title: Optimistic Updates
optimistic_updates.description: Pick how each device type should reflect commands. 'All' writes optimistic state immediately, 'None' waits for the API. For locks, 'None' is the safer choice when Adaptive Aggressive is on.

pick_lights.title: Optimistic Lights
pick_lights.description: Select the light devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected lights will wait for confirmed state.

pick_switches.title: Optimistic Switches
pick_switches.description: Select the switch devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected switches will wait for confirmed state.

pick_locks.title: Optimistic Locks
pick_locks.description: Select the lock devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected locks will wait for confirmed state. Recommended: leave locks unselected when Adaptive Aggressive is enabled.

adaptive_aggressive.title: Adaptive Aggressive Locks
adaptive_aggressive.description: After a lock or unlock command, poll that lock on a Fibonacci delay (1s, 2s, 3s, 5s, 8s) until the API confirms the commanded state. Recommended on. Does not change idle polling.

pick_adaptive_locks.title: Adaptive Aggressive Locks
pick_adaptive_locks.description: Select the locks that should use Adaptive Aggressive confirmation polling. Unselected locks stay on the idle poll interval.

polling_interval.title: Polling Interval
polling_interval.description: How often Home Assistant should poll the U-Tec API when idle. With Adaptive Aggressive enabled, 20 seconds is the recommended lock-safe interval. Raise further only if U-Tec push is actually arriving.
